# How to Preview and Choose a Gemini Voice in the Gemini Mobile App

> **In short:** Gemini's help center says you can listen to voice options in the Gemini mobile app, then confirm one to use across Gemini Apps features. You must be signed in, and the number of voices depends on your language.

Have you ever used a voice assistant that sounded a little off, with a rhythm that didn't feel right for you? Gemini lets you listen to its voice options and pick one. This guide shows you how to do that from the Gemini mobile app, step by step. It's written for anyone with Gemini on a phone who wants a voice that feels more comfortable to listen to.

## Before you start
- **A Gemini account, and you must be signed in.** The voice setting is tied to your account, so use the one you normally use.
- **The Gemini mobile app on your phone.** Gemini's help center says that, for now, this setting is only available in the mobile app, not in a web browser. That may change, so check the help center if you don't see it.
- **Your app language.** The help center notes that this option isn't available in every language, and the number of voices varies by language. Plan on about five minutes.

## Step 1 — Open the Gemini app and confirm your account
Tap the Gemini app icon on your phone's home screen or in your app list to open it. Once the app loads, look for your profile picture or initial, which usually sits in a corner of the screen. That shows which account you're using.

If the app asks you to sign in, do it now. You can't change the voice without being signed in to Gemini Apps. If your profile shows a different account than the one you normally use, sign out and sign back in with the correct one, since your voice choice belongs to that account.

You'll know it worked when your profile picture or initial matches the account you expect.

## Step 2 — Open the Menu at the left
Look at the left side of the screen for a control labeled **Menu**. Tap it. The help center describes this as the first thing to tap, so it should be easy to find, usually shown as a small icon.

If you don't see Menu, the screen may be showing a conversation in full view. Try going back to the main Gemini screen, then look again on the left side. Apps change their layout from time to time, so if the icon looks different on your phone, look for anything on the left edge that says Menu.

You'll know it worked when the Menu opens and shows more options, including Settings.

## Step 3 — Open Settings, then Gemini's Voice
In the Menu, find **Settings** and tap it. Then look for **Gemini's Voice**. The help center lists this as the path to the voice setting, so tap it when you see it. This screen is where the voice options are listed.

Your list may look different from the help center's description, and it may contain fewer voices than you expected. The number of options varies by language, so if you don't see Gemini's Voice at all, your app language may not support it. The help center explains how to check your language.

You'll know it worked when you can see a list of voice options on your screen.

## Step 4 — Listen to a voice by tapping its name
Tap a voice name once. The help center says that tapping a voice name lets you hear it, so you should hear a short voice sample. Tap another name and listen to that one too. Compare two or three voices before you decide. Pay attention to how clear it sounds, how fast it speaks and whether the rhythm feels comfortable to you.

Trust your ears here. Each voice sounds a little different, and none is the correct one. If a voice doesn't feel right, move on to the next one.

💬 Example: Say a short sentence to yourself, such as "Good morning, how are you today?" and notice which voice sounds the most natural to you.

You'll know it worked when tapping a name plays a sample of that voice.

## Step 5 — Confirm your choice
When you find a voice you like, tap **Confirm**. The help center uses this word for saving your choice. After you confirm, your selected voice becomes the one Gemini uses.

Note what the setting covers. According to the help center, this voice applies to all Gemini Apps features. It's used in Gemini Live, the spoken conversation mode, and in any feature where Gemini responds out loud, such as when you tap Listen next to a response. If you tap Listen on a reply, it should now use the voice you confirmed.

💬 Example: "Tell me a fun fact about [your favorite animal]."

You'll know it worked when Gemini's spoken replies sound like the voice you confirmed.

## Common mistakes
- **Thinking a tap on a name is saved.** Tapping a voice name only plays a sample. Your choice isn't set until you tap Confirm. Fix: after you find your favorite, tap Confirm, then check the setting again.
- **Looking for the voice setting on a computer.** The help center says the setting is only available in the mobile app for now. Fix: open the Gemini app on your phone and start from the Menu.
- **Expecting the voice to change the language.** A voice changes how Gemini sounds, not which language it understands. Fix: if you want a different language, check your app language in the help center's language instructions, then look at the voice list again.

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** If you use Gemini while cooking, driving or getting ready in the morning, a voice that feels comfortable can make listening to replies easier.
- **For your business or work:** If you listen to Gemini's spoken replies during your workday, choosing a voice you can understand clearly can make long listening sessions less tiring.
- **If you're just getting started:** Start with the first two voices you hear, pick the one you like, and remember you can change it later.

## Try it now
Open the Gemini app on your phone, tap Menu at the left, then go to Settings and Gemini's Voice. Tap two voice names, listen to both, and tap Confirm on the one you prefer.
